Palle Mark Christensen is a Danish general practitioner (praktiserende læge) based at the Lægerne Lærkevej clinic in Otterup [^src1]. He is actively involved in national healthcare quality development, specifically regarding cardiovascular health and the management of atrial fibrillation [^src1]. 

Christensen serves as a member of the steering committee for the [[databasen-for-atrieflimren-i-danmark|Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark]] [^src1]. His continued involvement in this governance role is documented across multiple annual reports, where he is listed as a member of the [[afdk-styregruppe|Styregruppen for AFDK]] in both the 2024 and 2025 publications [^src2] [^src3]. Through this committee, he contributes to the interdisciplinary and cross-sectoral oversight of the database, which tracks clinical outcomes, anticoagulation treatment practices, and quality indicators for atrial fibrillation patients across Denmark [^src2] [^src3].
